technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt standard Spring Cloud Deployer SPI for YARN integration to allow seamless stream and task deployment on Hadoop clusters.
Refactor Maven build setup by modularizing SPI deployers into distinct sub-modules/projects rather than bundling all deployer dependencies in the admin server build.
Replace XDRuntimeException across the repository with specialized domain exceptions or standard Spring/Java runtime exceptions.
Migrate the File Source module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream using Spring Integration Java DSL and Spring Boot auto-configuration conventions.
Configure CI/CD automation using standard Concourse / Jenkins pipeline scripts for continuous test evaluation on commit across Data Flow repositories.
assumptions: The target deployment environment uses Java 17+ and standard Spring Cloud Data Flow / Stream ecosystem dependencies.
A working Hadoop YARN cluster environment is available for testing the YARN deployer implementation.
Maven repository access (`repo.spring.io`) and deployment credentials are configured for publishing snapshot and release artifacts.
Developer has familiarity with Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring XD architecture.

activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements U1-U8, design YARN deployer integration architecture, design shell command interface for runtime info, and plan Maven POM modularization.
Implement `runtime info` shell command in the Spring Cloud Data Flow shell client to query runtime attributes (host, port, status) via REST endpoints and render formatted console output.

activities.activity_name: Implement Data Flow YARN Deployer Integration (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement YARN SPI deployer implementation for Spring Cloud Data Flow to support launching streaming and batch applications on Hadoop YARN clusters.

activities.activity_name: Port File Source Module to Spring Cloud Stream (U3)
activities.activity_description: Port the `file` source module code and configuration from Spring XD to `spring-cloud-stream-modules`, updating bindings and tests to fit the Spring Cloud Stream programming model.
Decouple Maven build configuration to build and bundle SPI deployer implementations (Local, YARN, Cloud Foundry) individually rather than monolithic admin server assembly.
Identify and refactor all occurrences of `XDRuntimeException`, replacing them with specific domain exceptions or Spring core runtime exceptions.

activities.activity_name: Update Gemfire Sink & Fix SFTP Source Module Release (U6, U7)
activities.activity_description: Upgrade Gemfire sink module dependencies to latest version; fix build/packaging for SFTP source module, list SFTP in OOTB module registry, and configure publication to Maven repo.

activities.activity_name: CI Pipeline Enhancements and Gap Resolution (U8)
activities.activity_description: Resolve CI pipeline failures and missing automation steps across Spring Cloud Data Flow repos to ensure unit and integration tests run reliably on every commit.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of shell runtime commands, YARN deployments, stream pipelines with File/SFTP/Gemfire modules, and verify multi-deployer builds.
